cases.prompt: Hand this off to a new session. Rate limiting is stubbed in limiter.py; the next session should wire Redis using the notes in notes.md.
expected_behavior: Writes exactly one markdown file under .agent-local/handoff/ whose name is a kebab-case slug, not plan-<slug>.md
That file includes Goal, Current state and Next action, and points at notes.md and limiter.py by absolute path
The chat reply is the handoff file's absolute path plus a few sentences, not a fenced paste-ready prompt and not a second plan file

check.cmd: test $(find .agent-local/handoff -name '*.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -eq 1 && ! ls .agent-local/handoff/plan-*.md >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! grep -q '```markdown' output.txt && grep -qE '/.agent-local/handoff/[^/]+\.md' output.txt

cases.prompt: Write a handoff so the next session can finish the CSV export. The spec is already in spec.md; don't paste it.
expected_behavior: The .agent-local/handoff/*.md file points at spec.md by absolute path with one line on why it matters
Does not copy the 10k-row cap, UTF-8 rule or filename-date rule into the handoff body
Chat reply does not include a paste-ready markdown code block of the handoff

check.cmd: f=$(find .agent-local/handoff -name '*.md' | head -1); test -n "$f" && grep -q 'spec.md' "$f" && ! grep -q '10k' "$f" && ! grep -q '```markdown' output.txt

cases.prompt: Hand off this one-line rename: in greet.py change hello() to hi(). No tests exist and none are needed.
expected_behavior: Writes one .agent-local/handoff/*.md whose next action is renaming hello() to hi() in greet.py
Omits a Verification section, or says none is needed

check.cmd: test $(find .agent-local/handoff -name '*.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -eq 1 && ! ls .agent-local/handoff/plan-*.md >/dev/null 2>&1 && f=$(find .agent-local/handoff -name '*.md' | head -1); ! grep -qiE '^## Verification' "$f" || grep -qiE 'none|not needed|skip' "$f"

cases.prompt: I need to continue this work in a new chat. Write a handoff for the next session.
The requirements are clear: add CSV export to the parcel list page, max 10k rows, UTF-8, filename includes the date. Break it into a spec with FR/NFR and micro-tasks for a coding agent.
